resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel worksheet list
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all worksheets (tabs) from the specified Excel file (OneDrive/SharePoint itemId required).

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel used range
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves the range of all used cells from the specified worksheet.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel tables
resourceTemplates.description: Returns a list of all tables (table objects) in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table rows
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all rows from a specific table in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel worksheet
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one worksheet by ID or name before it is renamed or deleted.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one table by ID or name before it is renamed, updated, or deleted.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table row
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one table row by its zero-based index before it is updated or deleted.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel cell range
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves a specific cell range (e.g., B2:F20) from a worksheet in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel named ranges
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all named ranges in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel named item
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one workbook-scoped named item by name before it is used or changed.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table columns
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all columns from a specific table in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel workbook metadata
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves basic metadata for the specified Excel workbook, including worksheet and table info.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel worksheet charts
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all charts from a specific worksheet in the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get worksheet tables
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all tables in a specific worksheet of the specified Excel file.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel worksheet comments
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all cell comments (notes) from the specified worksheet in an Excel file (OneDrive/SharePoint).

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel comment replies
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves all replies to a specific cell comment in the given worksheet of an Excel file (OneDrive/SharePoint).

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table column
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one table column by ID or name before it is updated or deleted.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel chart
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves one chart by ID or name before it is updated or deleted.

resourceTemplates.name: Get worksheet-scoped named items
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves named items scoped to one Excel worksheet.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel table sort state
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves the current sort state of one Excel table.

resourceTemplates.name: Get Excel range format
resourceTemplates.description: Retrieves formatting details for an Excel worksheet range.
